derivation: closed forms of elastic beam theory (S24 guided-cantilever method; S25 M. W. Kellogg, Design of Piping Systems, 2nd ed., 1956, cited for the method only) evaluated by scripts/closed_forms.py and scripts/lbend_flexibility.py; L-bend solved twice: unit-load flexibility integration and the frame3d stiffness solver (agree to 1e-9 rel)

material.note: inputs of the case, not material claims; 0.00225 = 2.70 in/100 ft (carbon steel 70 -> 400 degF, thermal_expansion_carbon_steel.json)

formulas.S: M / Z = 3 E D d / L^2

geometry.corner: sharp, no elbow flexibility (k = 1), straight Euler-Bernoulli legs

expectedWithAxial.reactionSign: force exerted by anchor C on the pipe, global x y

guidedCantileverApproximation.note: conservative vs 106.79 exact: the method ignores leg rotation

lBendTwoAnchors.tolerance: 1e-4 rel on reactions and moments (frame solver), 1e-3 rel on Smax
